text.description_html:
Omnia 14723, Beaded Oval Narrow Trim Knobset

The Oval Beaded Narrow Plate Latchset is a great way to add traditional beauty to your home. The subtle beading on both the knob and the matching plate add just enough elegant detailing to be at home amongst the fanciest décors or it can add a point of interest to simpler spaces. The narrow escutcheon plate is surface mounted. For interior doors with 1-3/8" thicknesses and either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets. Available in single dummy, double dummy, passage, or privacy functions.

Features of the Oval Beaded Narrow Plate Latchset:

  • 28 degrees rotation to retract latch.
  • All critical interior parts are made of brass. Tough, non-rusting materials are used throughout.
  • For commercial and residential use.
  • For interior use only.
  • Privacy function features a privacy mortise bolt constructed of a metal case and featuring a solid brass bolt underneath the knob and latch. It has an emergency release on outside plate.
  • The narrow escutcheon plate is surface mounted. Does Not fit standard 2-1/8" bore hole door prep.

Specifications for the Interior Beaded Oval Narrow Rose with Matching Knob:

  • Knob Length: 2-1/2"
  • Knob Projection: 2-3/8"
  • Backplate Height: 9-3/16"
  • Backplate Width: 1-9/16"
  • Backplate Projection: 1/4"
  • Privacy Function Turnpiece: 1-5/8" x 1-1/8 proj.
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8"
  • Backset: either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim on one side of door. It does not lock and does not latch. Complete set includes: 1 knob, 1 backplate, and mounting hardware.
  • Double Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim on both sides of door. It does not lock and does not latch. Complete set includes: 2 knobs, 2 backplates, and mounting hardware.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates by knob from either side of door. Complete set includes: 2 knobs, 2 thru-bolt assembly backplates, tubular latch, spindle and mounting hardware.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. Upper latch operates by knob from either side of door. Locks by privacy bolt with turnpiece on inside an emergency release on outside plate. Complete set includes: 2 knobs, 2 thru-bolt assembly backplates, spindle, mounting hardware, privacy turnpiece, knob operated tubular latch, and thumbturn operated privacy mortise bolt and case.
